original_question: Determine whether the L2 action functional for two-dimensional ideal hydrodynamics satisfies the Palais-Smale condition.
target_in_paper: Section 5.3, Problem 9: "Does the energy (action) functional corresponding to the L^2 kinetic energy metric (1.3) in 2D hydrodynamics satisfy the Palais–Smale condition?" ([math.toronto.edu](https://www.math.toronto.edu/khesin/papers/Problems_in_GHD2205.01143.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the specific compactness question, the L^2 energy/action functional, and the two-dimensional ideal-hydrodynamics setting; this is essentially the paper’s Problem 9. ([math.toronto.edu](https://www.math.toronto.edu/khesin/papers/Problems_in_GHD2205.01143.pdf))
missing_details: The paper places the problem on the volume-preserving diffeomorphism group, more precisely on its Sobolev completion D^s_μ(M), rather than on an unspecified hydrodynamic state space. ([math.toronto.edu](https://www.math.toronto.edu/khesin/papers/Problems_in_GHD2205.01143.pdf))
The underlying domain is a compact two-dimensional Riemannian manifold M with volume form μ. ([math.toronto.edu](https://www.math.toronto.edu/khesin/papers/Problems_in_GHD2205.01143.pdf))

The L^2 object is not an arbitrary functional: it is the energy/action induced by the right-invariant kinetic-energy metric (1.3) on D_μ(M). ([math.toronto.edu](https://www.math.toronto.edu/khesin/papers/Problems_in_GHD2205.01143.pdf))
The nearby explicit formula is E(γ) = (1/2)∫_0^1 ||γ̇(t)||^2_{L^2} dt, introduced in Problem 8(ii). ([math.toronto.edu](https://www.math.toronto.edu/khesin/papers/Problems_in_GHD2205.01143.pdf))

The Sobolev regularity threshold in the surrounding setup is s > n/2 + 1; since the question is 2D, this means s > 2. ([math.toronto.edu](https://www.math.toronto.edu/khesin/papers/Problems_in_GHD2205.01143.pdf))

Problem 9 is explicitly stated as related to Problem 8, so the two-point variational context and prescribed-endpoint interpretation are implicit in the paper but absent from the draft. ([math.toronto.edu](https://www.math.toronto.edu/khesin/papers/Problems_in_GHD2205.01143.pdf))
refined_question: Let M be a compact two-dimensional Riemannian manifold with volume form μ, let D^s_μ(M) denote the Sobolev H^s completion of the group of volume-preserving diffeomorphisms with s > 2, and equip D^s_μ(M) with the right-invariant L^2 kinetic-energy metric (1.3). For the associated energy/action functional E(γ) = (1/2)∫_0^1 ||γ̇(t)||^2_{L^2} dt on curves γ in D^s_μ(M) joining prescribed endpoints (as in the two-point variational problem), does E satisfy the Palais–Smale condition? ([math.toronto.edu](https://www.math.toronto.edu/khesin/papers/Problems_in_GHD2205.01143.pdf))
justification: The draft is targeting the paper’s official formulation in Section 5.3 rather than a broader neighboring problem, so the refined question stays with Problem 9 itself. To make it stand alone without broadening it, I imported only the immediate hidden setup supplied nearby: Section 1 defines the right-invariant L^2 kinetic-energy metric (1.3) on D_μ(M); Section 5.2 introduces the Sobolev completion D^s_μ(M), the condition s > n/2 + 1, and the exact energy functional E(γ) used in the related two-point variational problem; and Section 5.3 then asks whether this energy/action functional satisfies the Palais–Smale condition in 2D hydrodynamics. The paper does not explicitly prove any equivalent reformulation of Problem 9, so no alternate version is supplied. ([math.toronto.edu](https://www.math.toronto.edu/khesin/papers/Problems_in_GHD2205.01143.pdf))
